preconditions.description: The number of drawings, n, is between 2 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of trees to recover, k, is exactly 2.

postconditions.description: The output indicates that it is possible to recover the two trees.
The number of tree pairs in the output matches the input number of drawings, n.

postconditions.expression: all(pair in input_drawings for pair in tree_pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair of trees in the output is found in the input drawings.

postconditions.expression: all(pair[0] > pair[1] for pair in tree_pairs)
postconditions.description: Each pair of trees in the output has the larger tree number first.
